title: Used to
note: Past habit that has stopped. Not past simple (one time). Not would. Not be used to (B2). Sort: habit / one time (not the word used to). Quiz/Type whole VP. Use is error correction (use_mode: correct). · 2026-08-29 smoke.

items.cz: V květnu jsem se učil angličtinu.

items.en: I used to live in Brno.
items.cz: Dřív jsem bydlel v Brně. Teď už ne.
items.gap: I ____ in Brno. I don't now. (live)
accepts: I used to live in Brno.
items.explanation: **used to live** = a habit, many times. Not *lived (one time).
items.explanation_cz: **used to live** = dřív, teď ne. Ne *lived (jednou).
items.wrong: I used to living in Brno.

items.en: She used to live in Prague.
items.cz: Dřív bydlela v Praze. Teď už ne.
items.gap: She ____ in Prague. She doesn't now. (live)
accepts: She used to live in Prague.
items.explanation: she → **used to live**. A habit. Not *lived (one time).
items.explanation_cz: she → **used to live**. Dřív, teď ne. Ne *lived.
items.wrong: She use to live in Prague.

items.cz: Dřív jsem hrál tenis. Teď už ne.
accepts: I used to play tennis.
items.explanation: **used to play** = habit, stopped. Not *played yesterday.
items.explanation_cz: **used to play** = zvyk, skončil. Ne *played včera.
items.wrong: I used to playing tennis.

items.cz: Dřív jsme hráli fotbal. Teď už ne.
accepts: We used to play football.
We used to play soccer.
items.explanation: **used to play** football. We don't now.
items.explanation_cz: **used to play** fotbal. Teď už ne.
items.wrong: We used to played football.

items.en: I used to work in Prague.
items.cz: Dřív jsem pracoval v Praze. Teď už ne.
items.gap: I ____ in Prague. I don't now. (work)
accepts: I used to work in Prague.
items.explanation: **used to work** there. Not *worked in 2019.
items.explanation_cz: **used to work** tam. Ne *worked v roce 2019.
items.wrong: I used to working in Prague.

items.cz: Dřív tady pracoval. Teď už ne.
accepts: He used to work here.
items.explanation: he → **used to work** here. Stopped.
items.explanation_cz: he → **used to work** tady. Skončilo to.
items.wrong: He use to work here.

items.en: I used to walk to school.
items.cz: Dřív jsem chodil pěšky do školy. Teď už ne.
items.gap: I ____ to school. I don't now. (walk)
accepts: I used to walk to school.
items.explanation: **used to walk** every day. Not *walked yesterday.
items.explanation_cz: **used to walk** každý den. Ne *walked včera.
items.wrong: I used to walking to school.

items.en: I used to have a dog.
items.cz: Dřív jsem měl psa. Teď už ne.
items.gap: I ____ a dog. I don't now. (have)
accepts: I used to have a dog.
items.explanation: **used to have** = past state, not now. Not *had last year.
items.explanation_cz: **used to have** = minulý stav, teď ne. Ne *had loni.
items.wrong: I used to had a dog.

items.cz: Dřív jsem byl tichý. Teď už ne.
items.gap: I ____ quiet. I am not now. (be)
accepts: I used to be quiet.
items.explanation: **used to be** quiet. States too: be / have. Not now.
items.explanation_cz: **used to be** tichý. I stavy: be / have. Teď ne.
items.wrong: I used to being quiet.

items.cz: Dřív jsem jedl maso. Teď už ne.
accepts: I used to eat meat.
items.explanation: **used to eat** meat. The habit stopped.
items.explanation_cz: **used to eat** maso. Zvyk skončil.
items.wrong: I use to eat meat.

accepts: She used to cook.
items.explanation: she → **used to cook**. Not *was cooking at six.
items.explanation_cz: she → **used to cook**. Ne *was cooking v šest.
items.wrong: She used to cooking.

items.en: I used to get up early.
items.cz: Dřív jsem vstával brzy. Teď už ne.
items.gap: I ____ early. I don't now. (get up)
accepts: I used to get up early.
items.explanation: **used to get up** early. Habit, stopped.
items.explanation_cz: **used to get up** brzy. Zvyk, skončil.
items.wrong: I used to got up early.

items.en: He didn't use to like coffee.
accepts: He didn't use to like coffee.
He did not use to like coffee.
items.explanation: **didn't use to like**. After **didn't**: **use**, not *used.
items.explanation_cz: **didn't use to like**. Po **didn't**: **use**, ne *used.
items.wrong: He didn't used to like coffee.

accepts: She didn't use to drive.
She did not use to drive.
items.explanation: she → **didn't use to drive**. **use** after didn't.
items.explanation_cz: she → **didn't use to drive**. **use** po didn't.
items.wrong: She didn't used to drive.

items.en: We didn't use to have internet.
accepts: We didn't use to have internet.
We did not use to have internet.
items.explanation: **didn't use to have** internet. We do now.
items.explanation_cz: **didn't use to have** internet. Teď ano.
items.wrong: We didn't used to have internet.

items.en: He didn't use to live here.
accepts: He didn't use to live here.
He did not use to live here.
items.explanation: he → **didn't use to live** here. He does now.
items.explanation_cz: he → **didn't use to live** tady. Teď ano.
items.wrong: He didn't used to live here.

accepts: I didn't use to cook.
I did not use to cook.
items.explanation: **didn't use to cook**. I do now. **use**, not *used.
items.explanation_cz: **didn't use to cook**. Teď vařím. **use**, ne *used.
items.wrong: I didn't used to cook.

items.en: They didn't use to watch TV.
items.cz: Dřív nekoukali na televizi. Teď ano.
accepts: They didn't use to watch TV.
They did not use to watch TV.
They didn't use to watch television.
They did not use to watch television.
items.explanation: **didn't use to watch** TV. They do now.
items.explanation_cz: **didn't use to watch** televizi. Teď ano.
items.wrong: They didn't used to watch TV.

items.en: Did you use to live in Brno?
accepts: Did you use to live in Brno?
items.explanation: **Did you use to live?** After **Did**: **use to**, not *used to.
items.explanation_cz: **Did you use to live?** Po **Did**: **use to**, ne *used to.
items.wrong: Did you used to live in Brno?

items.en: Did you use to play tennis?
accepts: Did you use to play tennis?
items.explanation: **Did you use to play?** Not *Did you used to.
items.explanation_cz: **Did you use to play?** Ne *Did you used to.
items.wrong: Did you used to play tennis?

items.en: Did they use to work here?
accepts: Did they use to work here?
items.explanation: **Did they use to work** here? **use to** after Did.
items.explanation_cz: **Did they use to work** tady? **use to** po Did.
items.wrong: Did they used to work here?

items.en: Did she use to be quiet?
accepts: Did she use to be quiet?
items.explanation: **Did she use to be** quiet? After Did: **use to be**, not *was.
items.explanation_cz: **Did she use to be** tichá? Po Did: **use to be**, ne *was.
items.wrong: Did she used to be quiet?

items.en: Did you use to walk to school?
items.cz: Chodil jsi dřív pěšky do školy?
accepts: Did you use to walk to school?
items.explanation: **Did you use to walk** to school? **use**, not *used.
items.explanation_cz: **Did you use to walk** do školy? **use**, ne *used.
items.wrong: Did you used to walk to school?

accepts: Did you use to cook?
items.explanation: **Did you use to cook?** Not *Did you used to cook?
items.explanation_cz: **Did you use to cook?** Ne *Did you used to cook?
items.wrong: Did you used to cook?

cards.title: Used to
points: A **habit** in the past — **repeated**. It has **stopped**.
Same time as **I played** (one day). Not earlier.

cards.title: Form
points: Same form for I / you / he.
Negative: **didn't use**. After **Did**: **use to**, not ~~used to~~.
